description: Synthetic CitizenReport/Incident seed records for demoing the ThirdWave operational loop (spec Section 9 entities), reconstructed from public news coverage of real historical Accra flood events. These are NOT live citizen submissions -- they exist to let the team walk through Report Incident -> verify -> Incident -> assign responder -> resolve end to end using a locally recognizable, real disaster instead of placeholder data. Must be clearly labeled as historical/demo data in any UI that renders them, per the spec's own rule that a report must never imply it is already official (Section 5) -- the same discipline applies doubly to reconstructed historical data.

citizen_reports.description: Severe flooding at Kwame Nkrumah Circle (Odawna) following heavy rainfall. Water levels rising rapidly near the interchange and fuel station.
citizen_reports.source_note: Reconstructed from public reporting, not a live submission

incidents.response_notes: Historical demo record: over 200 deaths (flood + fuel station explosion combined), per contemporary reporting. Grid cell grid_r11_c14 (Ablekuma North) scored 33.0/100 (top 14% of 319 cells) in ThirdWave's own vulnerability grid -- despite the containing assembly (Ablekuma North) ranking lowest of 6 assemblies at 23.1.
Historical demo record: 3 deaths. Same site as the 2015 event, flooding again 8 years later -- independent confirmation of a recurring hotspot the assembly-level score missed both times.
